metadata.question: Did the Central Valley of California experience at least 15 inches of rainfall between October 2022 and March 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need precipitation data for Central Valley of California from October 2022 to March 2023. CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is the best dataset for global precipitation at 0.05° resolution. 2. Masking strategy: Precipitation data doesn't need cloud masking, but we should check for valid data. 3. Logic: Sum precipitation over the period, convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm), and check if >= 15 inches. Data quality checks: - Check if collection has images - Check if valid pixels exist after processing - Validate the result is reasonable (not NaN, within expected range) Central Valley of California coordinates roughly: [-122.5, 36.5], [-121.0, 40.5] ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const centralValley = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-122.5, 36.5], [-121.0, 36.5], [-121.0, 40.5], [-122.5, 40.5], [-122.5, 36.5] ]); const startDate = '2022-10-01'; const endDate = '2023-03-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation data const precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(centralValley); const precipSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Precipitation images: ${precipSize}`); if (precipSize === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data found."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: centralValley, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid precipitation pixels."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation and convert mm to inches const meanPrecip = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: centralValley, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const inchesPrecip = meanPrecip / 25.4; // Convert mm to inches // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Mean precipitation: ${inchesPrecip.toFixed(2)} inches`); console.log(`Pixels analyzed: ${pixelCount}`); if (inchesPrecip === null || isNaN(inchesPrecip) || inchesPrecip < 0 || inchesPrecip > 100) { console.log("C3"); } else if (inchesPrecip >= 15) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
